contingency: Partner down: haul home by cart from the access cell, 108 min (casualty 179 kg; haul parameters assumed); outside the 60-min partner line.
drag_note: One astronaut cannot drag a suited crewmate on Mars without a cart or sled: the pull needed exceeds boot grip even on flat ground.

access.rule: nearest cell with cell state assessed and a walk home in the scenario, within access_radius_m of the science point; walk-in leg not modelled

skyline_error_scope: median |detected - predicted| skyline elevation per distance class on this card's Navcam frame (automatic sky detector, no manual review, D7; far class not validated: the far rim is hidden by haze in north-facing frames)
landmarks_note: only 0 landmark(s) qualify (fewer than 3): the others are below the computed skyline and farther than 5 km
